name: JOHN COST
heroDescription:
I’m an early-career computational biology and scientific software creator with a background in biology, data analysis, and research workflows. I focus on building clear and reliable pipelines that turn experimental or scientific data into results for researchers and teams.

I graduated from Carnegie Mellon University with a B.A. in Biology and a minor in Computational Biology. My coursework and projects span algorithms, machine learning, and systems, alongside laboratory biology and chemistry.

I’m particularly interested in roles where I can work at the interface of biology, data, and operations, helping teams create and scale new analyses, tools, and workflows.
